description: Takes a list of cases or tickets (case, date, description, optional cause, owner, status, supplier) and groups them into ten recurring causes by keywords (invoice without purchase order, price difference, quantity or goods receipt, master data, approval stuck, payment or reminder, late delivery, quality or complaint, duplicate invoice, invoice details or tax). A cause column takes priority. Returns the five most frequent causes with share, open cases and the fix with the matching Workbench tool, typical age, cases older than 30 days, open cases per owner and suppliers with three or more cases. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

issues.description: Rows: case, date, description, cause (optional), owner, status (open or done), supplier. German column names work too.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

name: analyse_issues
title: Issue radar: recurring causes in a list of procurement or invoice problems, age, open cases per owner and the fix for each cause
